Long-running OperationAgent subprocesses start in a separate process group.

signal after a grace period. This covers descendants created by that operation;

sensitive values are persisted. Authorization headers, API keys, passwords,
database URLs, email addresses, and phone-like values are covered by the

Scope: evidence rules implemented by the YieldMind knowledge and safety tools.

Each indexed chunk has a stable `chunk_id`, `text_hash`, `document_id`,
`document_version`, and `index_version`. Reports should retain these fields
together with the source path so a cited passage can be checked later.

A valid chunk ID proves that an indexed chunk exists and matches its stored
hash. It does not prove that the chunk semantically supports the generated
claim. Citation accuracy therefore needs labeled relevance checks or human
review in addition to identifier validation.

An index profile locks provider, model ID, revision, vector dimension,
normalization, metric, and query/document instructions. Different embedding
dimensions or model profiles must not share one Chroma collection. Re-indexing
uses a new index version or isolated collection.

Ingestion stores the document hash and version. Repeating the same source hash
and index version is idempotent. Deleting a document marks its metadata as
deleted and removes its vectors so normal retrieval does not cite it.

Scope: repository evaluation rules and acceptance semantics. Numerical model

Training-set fit metrics are not accepted as generalization evidence. Baseline

## Cancellation

Long-running OperationAgent subprocesses start in a separate process group.
Cancellation or timeout sends termination to the group and escalates to a kill
signal after a grace period. This covers descendants created by that operation;
ordinary synchronous Python tools still stop only at their supported boundary.

## Secret handling

Tool arguments, results, and event payloads pass through redaction before
sensitive values are persisted. Authorization headers, API keys, passwords,
database URLs, email addresses, and phone-like values are covered by the
current redaction checks. Redaction reduces exposure but is not encryption.

## Offline and live modes

The offline rule planner is deterministic and records zero model calls. Real
Function Calling requires `allow_live_llm=true` and must report actual call
counts separately. Simulated adapters and skipped live tests are not evidence
of real model behavior.

## Retry and termination budgets

Workflow repair, revision, Tool Calling, and anomaly drill-down need explicit
limits. A failed verifier can route to a bounded local repair or replan, while
cancellation routes to a terminal state and should not silently continue work.

# Evidence And Index Governance

Scope: evidence rules implemented by the YieldMind knowledge and safety tools.

## Stable evidence identity

Each indexed chunk has a stable `chunk_id`, `text_hash`, `document_id`,
`document_version`, and `index_version`. Reports should retain these fields
together with the source path so a cited passage can be checked later.

## Traceability versus semantic support

A valid chunk ID proves that an indexed chunk exists and matches its stored
hash. It does not prove that the chunk semantically supports the generated
claim. Citation accuracy therefore needs labeled relevance checks or human
review in addition to identifier validation.

# Evaluation And Mechanism Ablation

Scope: repository evaluation rules and acceptance semantics. Numerical model
performance must come from an actual run artifact, never from this document.

## Out-of-fold evaluation

Training-set fit metrics are not accepted as generalization evidence. Baseline
and candidate comparisons use held-out or out-of-fold predictions under the
same split definition. The split seed and fold count belong in the run record.

## Metrics

Regression reports may include RMSE, MAE, and R2. RMSE preserves the target
unit and emphasizes larger errors; MAE is more robust to a small number of
large residuals; R2 is scale-relative and can be negative on held-out data.

训练集拟合指标不能作为泛化能力的证据。基线与候选方案应在相同的数据划分下，使用留出预测或折外预测进行比较。划分随机种子和折数应写入运行记录。

回归报告可以包含 RMSE、MAE 和 R2。RMSE 保留目标变量单位并更强调大误差；MAE 对少量大残差更稳健；R2 是与尺度相关的指标，在留出数据上可能为负数。

## Cancellation

Long-running OperationAgent subprocesses start in a separate process group.
Cancellation or timeout sends termination to the group and escalates to a kill
signal after a grace period. This covers descendants created by that operation;
ordinary synchronous Python tools still stop only at their supported boundary.

## Secret handling

Tool arguments, results, and event payloads pass through redaction before
sensitive values are persisted. Authorization headers, API keys, passwords,
database URLs, email addresses, and phone-like values are covered by the
current redaction checks. Redaction reduces exposure but is not encryption.

长时间运行的 OperationAgent 子进程在独立进程组中启动。取消或超时时，系统会向整个进程组发送终止信号，并在宽限期后升级为强制杀死信号。这会覆盖该操作创建的后代进程；普通同步 Python 工具仍然只能在其支持的边界停止。

Column aliases alone are insufficient. A run should preserve the target unit,

Scope: repository evaluation rules and acceptance semantics. Numerical model

Training-set fit metrics are not accepted as generalization evidence. Baseline
